name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2123: The console disk reading is polled every 900 seconds and it is the number he acts on when deciding whether he can record. Measured tonight on his live console, the footer said 4.7GB free and BELOW the floor while the disk actually held 8.3GB, because space had been freed since the last poll, which would have sent him hunting for room he already had. The gate itself was never wrong because the on route re-measures for itself. Only the sentence he reads was wrong. The disk sentence now carries the age of the thing it measured, and an unstamped reading says UNKNOWN rather than reading as fresh.
